io.webagent4j.extraction
 

  • Uses of ExtractionResult in io.webagent4j.browser

    Methods in io.webagent4j.browser that return ExtractionResult
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    default <T> ExtractionResult<T>
    IFrame.extract(ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves request's source against this frame's current document to one unambiguous element and reads, converts, and validates its data - re-resolving this frame's own pending-scope chain fresh on every poll exactly like IFrame.locate(io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition) already does, so a frame that disappears, is replaced, or becomes ambiguous mid-wait is caught the same way.
    default <T> ExtractionResult<T>
    IPage.extract(ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves request's source against this page's current document to one unambiguous element and reads, converts, and validates its data - reusing the exact same locator resolution IPage.locate(io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition) does, not a second DOM search.
    default <T> ExtractionResult<List<T>>
    IFrame.extractList(ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves every element request's source matches inside this frame, and reads, converts, and validates each one's data in DOM order.
    default <T> ExtractionResult<List<T>>
    IPage.extractList(ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves every element request's source matches against this page's current document, and reads, converts, and validates each one's data in DOM order.
    default ExtractionResult<ExtractedTable>
    IFrame.extractTable(LocatorDefinition source)
    Resolves source to one accessible HTML table inside this frame and reads its structure.
    default ExtractionResult<ExtractedTable>
    IPage.extractTable(LocatorDefinition source)
    Resolves source to one accessible HTML table on this page and reads its structure.

    Modifier and Type

    default <T> ExtractionResult<T>
    IElement.extract(ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Reads, converts, and validates request's datum directly from this already-resolved element - never a locator search, since the element is already the one the caller was told was selected.

  • Uses of ExtractionResult in io.webagent4j.extraction

    Methods in io.webagent4j.extraction that return ExtractionResult
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    <T> ExtractionResult<T>
    ExtractionEngine.extract(ILiveLocatorContext context, ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves request's source to one unambiguous element (ILocatorEngine.locateSingle(io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorContext, io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition)) and reads, converts, and validates its data.
    <T> ExtractionResult<List<T>>
    ExtractionEngine.extractList(ILiveLocatorContext context, ExtractionRequest<T> request)
    Resolves every element request's source matches (ILocatorEngine.locateAll(io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorContext, io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition)), reads, converts, and validates each one's data, and returns the results in DOM order (LocatorCandidate.domOrder()) - the deterministic order a caller asking for a whole collection expects, which is not necessarily the engine's internal rank order.
    ExtractionResult<ExtractedTable>
    ExtractionEngine.extractTable(ILiveLocatorContext context, LocatorDefinition source)
    Resolves source to one accessible HTML table (ILocatorEngine.locateSingle(io.webagent4j.locator.LocatorContext, io.webagent4j.locator.api.LocatorDefinition)) and reads its structure: headers from the table's own direct thead > tr > th/ thead > tr > td (empty when the table has no thead - never guessed from an untagged first row), and every direct tbody/tfoot/table-level tr not inside a thead, each row's cells read from its own direct th/td children in DOM order.
